name: diarium
description: Agent memory as a verifiable UST stream — a task closes, the agent writes what it learned, the entry is sealed and prev-chained. Tamper-evident, offline-verifiable, no server.

ust:browser.why: A command-line tool over a filesystem store: it seals entries, reads a chain from disk and holds a signing key from the environment. Every one of those is a Node capability, and none of them is something a page should be doing.
